Privacy Policy

How we process personal data when you visit this website or contact us.

Last updated: October 2026

Controller

The controller responsible for data processing on this website is: Lexora Digital (Goran Kolouh), Rue Jean Robbie 44, 1060 Saint-Gilles (Bruxelles), Belgium, gdpr@lexoradigital.com. Further details are in our legal notice.

Hosting and server logs

This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA. When you visit the site, the hosting provider automatically processes technical data such as IP address, date and time, requested page, browser and operating system, in order to deliver the website and keep it secure.

Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in a secure, working website). Transfers to the USA are based on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and/or standard contractual clauses. Retention: a maximum of 30 days.

Contact form and GDPR & cookie check

When you use one of our forms, we process the details you enter (for example name, email address, website address, country and message) to answer your request or carry out the check you asked for.

Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (steps prior to a contract at your request) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (answering enquiries). The forms are processed by Formspree, Inc., USA, on the basis of a data processing agreement and the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and/or standard contractual clauses.

We delete your enquiry when it is no longer needed, unless statutory retention obligations apply no later than 12 months after the enquiry has been completed.

Email

If you email us, we process your email address and message to reply. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR.

Cookies and local storage

This website does not use cookies for analytics, advertising or tracking. If you choose a language, that choice is stored in your browser's local storage so that the site opens in your language next time. This is strictly necessary for a function you requested and is not sent to us. Details are in our cookie policy.

Fonts and external resources

All fonts and scripts are hosted on our own server. No data is sent to Google Fonts or other third-party content networks when you view this website.

Your rights

  • Access to your data (Art. 15 GDPR)
  • Rectification (Art. 16 GDPR)
  • Erasure (Art. 17 GDPR)
  • Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
  • Data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
  • Objection to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR)

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your habitual residence or place of work the Belgian Data Protection Authority (Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit / Autorité de protection des données), Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels, www.dataprotectionauthority.be.

Changes

We update this policy when our website or the law changes. The current version is always available on this page.
